mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have a temperature of 61 degrees with overcast conditions at Reddan Soccer Park and the moon is in its first quarter phase.
The City of Verona encourages residents to stay informed by subscribing to our digital newsletter, which covers the latest city projects and community programs.

There is plenty to do this week in Verona, including yoga at Insight Wellness today and Hop Haus Trivia happening this evening. Looking ahead, you can catch live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard and the Wisconsin Brewing Company starting tomorrow.
In a report from September 5th, local officers responded to a series of calls regarding vehicles found with slices of cheese on their windshields as part of a social media prank.
Culver's of Verona is currently undergoing a remodel and will be opening its doors today at 10:00 AM.
